description: This file defines the NationalityDao class, which manages database operations related to 'Nationality' entities, including saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting nationalities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: NationalityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing 'Nationality' entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and queries related to nationalities.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Persists a Nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Nationality entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for navigating through nationalism query results according to specified filters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Counts the total number of nationality records matching the provided filters.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingNationalityIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing nationality IDs from a given set of IDs.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes nationalities by a list of IDs and returns the number of affected records.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality with the given name exists in the database.
